text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"states a position, gives pros and cons, then argues a risk of texting and driving","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay does more than state an opinion by developing a line of reasoning that connects the topic to a specific danger."},{"evidence":"mentions \"people texting and driving\" and \"more crashes\" leading to \"more death\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay explains the consequences of its point rather than stopping at a brief claim."},{"evidence":"includes \"These cars would use half the fuel...\" and \"far more flexibility than a bus\"","quality":"use of source details","description":"The essay incorporates information from the article to ground its argument in the given text."},{"evidence":"has a clear opener, a middle paragraph, and a concluding judgment that it is \"a bad idea\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured into an introduction, body, and conclusion."}]}
